---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to GitHub Engineer
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What is the maintainer pain you are trying to solve? Be specific: a one-line
feature description is not enough — describe the **workflow** that needs
improving and what is broken about the current behaviour.

## Proposed solution

What would you like to see, in concrete terms? Reference existing commands
(`ghe --pipeline`, `ghe --show-latest`) when possible so the change is easy
to scope.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you weigh? Why is this one better for a maintainer
who only has a few minutes each week?

## Out of scope

What adjacent changes are tempting but should **not** be in this PR? The
v1.0 release is intentionally minimal; "while we are at it" scope creep
delays shipping.

## Additional context

Links to upstream issues, design docs, or community discussion. A short
screen recording is welcome when the proposed UX is hard to describe in text.
